messages.text: At 16¢ that's about $18 a month for the NerdOctaxe, $359.99 up front. People buy it to stack sats and keep a block shot running 24/7 — first miner, or adding to a setup?
Any miners able to mine two cryptos at once?
Searched the catalog · Hammer Miner Scrypt DC02 Dogecoin Litecoin

Yes — the Scrypt units. Dogecoin and Litecoin are merge-mined, so one machine earns both at once (plus small ones like Bells and PepeCoin). The Hammer DC02 is $239.99, 105 MH/s at about 25 W — roughly $3 a month at your rate.

Bitcoin's a separate algorithm, so no box does BTC plus Doge. Want the Doge/LTC side too?

context.pop: At 10¢ the NerdOctaxe runs about $12 a month, at 16¢ about $18 — what do you pay for power?
